newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian R&D may shift offshore - Deloitte.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian R&D may shift offshore - Deloitte.

text.p: One third of large Australian Australian companies may shift their research and development (R&D) operations offshore following a government decision to reduce tax concessions for R&D, according to a survey released on Monday by accountancy group Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu.

The survey showed that 34 percent of companies that responded and that had previously claimed the Australian tax concession were considering whether they should move their operations offshore to qualify for more favourable R&D tax concession schemes such as those in Malaysia and Singapore.

"This movement of revenue earning capacity and technology to foreign countries will cause serious long-term damage to the Australian economy and greatly diminish the government's future taxation revenue," Deloitte said in a statement.
The federal coalition government reduced the R&D tax concession from 150 percent to 125 percent in its August budget.
Deloitte said the reduction in the tax concession was dissuading Australian companies from undertaking R&D activities.

"The government is sending a clear message to companies that, despite its rhetoric, the government is not willing to properly support R&D activities conducted in this country," Deloitte said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
